ASPCApro provides tools and resources for animal welfare professionals. We've combined information and knowledge from our experts to share with shelters and other animal welfare professionals.

We encourage participation and hope you will share your opinions on our issues. By taking part in discussions on our page, you are agreeing to the policy outlined below.

We reserve the right to delete posts containing the following: profanity, personal attacks, offensive language
